abstract: During the last 54 years at the Children's Hospital 11 children (10 female, 1 male) had been treated for an extragonadal germ cell tumor arising in the retroperitoneum. There were eight teratomas (five mature, three immature), two endodermal sinus tumors and one tumor with a mixture of both components. Abdominal pain or discomfort was the usual presenting complaint, with the average age at diagnosis being 18 months. On physical examination, each child had a palpable abdominal mass usually localized in the upper quadrants. The finding of calcification, bone or teeth, on radiologic study was most helpful in establishing a preoperative diagnosis of teratoma. The preferred treatment for children with mature and immature teratomas is complete surgical resection; decisions regarding adjuvant therapy for patients with immature tumors must be evaluated on an individual basis. The prognosis remains guarded for children with unresectable primaries or those with endodermal sinus tumor. Of three tumor-related deaths, two were due to metastatic endodermal sinus tumor and one resulted from extensive local growth by immature teratoma. Successful management of children with endodermal sinus tumor requires surgery aimed at debulking or complete resection in combination with aggressive adjuvant chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 過去54年間に当小児病院で治療を受けた、後腹膜に発生した性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の小児11例(女児10例、男児1例)を対象とした。内訳は奇形腫8例(成熟奇形腫5例、未熟奇形腫3例)、卵黄嚢腫瘍2例、両成分を含む腫瘍1例であった。主訴は腹痛または不快感が多く、平均診断年齢は18か月であった。全例で上腹部を中心に触知可能な腹部腫瘤を認めた。X線で骨や歯の石灰化を認めたことが、奇形腫の術前診断に最も有用であった。成熟奇形腫および未熟奇形腫の小児に対しては、外科的切除が第一選択である。未熟奇形腫に対する補助療法の要否は、個々の症例で判断すべきである。切除不能な原発巣や卵黄嚢腫瘍をもつ小児の予後は不良なままである。腫瘍関連死3例のうち2例は転移性卵黄嚢腫瘍によるもので、1例は未熟奇形腫の局所進展によるものであった。卵黄嚢腫瘍をもつ小児の治療には、減量手術または完全切除と、積極的な補助化学療法の併用が必要である。
